mapper.select: SELECT FROM notification WHERE publisher_id = #{publisherId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE publisher_id = #{publisherId}

SELECT IFNULL(n.batch_id, CONCAT('single_', n.id)) as batch_id, n.id, n.title, n.description, n.type, n.publisher_id as publisher_id, n.create_time as create_time, 1 as receiver_count, CASE WHEN n.is_read = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as read_count FROM notification n WHERE n.publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND n.batch_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT n.batch_id as batch_id, MIN(n.id) as id, n.title, n.description, n.type, n.publisher_id as publisher_id, MIN(n.create_time) as create_time, COUNT(n.id) as receiver_count, SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_read = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as read_count FROM notification n WHERE n.publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND n.batch_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.batch_id, n.title, n.description, n.type, n.publisher_id
ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM notification WHERE publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND batch_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT batch_id) as cnt FROM notification WHERE publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND batch_id IS NOT NULL ) as sub

SELECT n.id, n.receiver_id as receiver_id, n.is_read as is_read, n.create_time as create_time, IFNULL(u.username, n.receiver_id) as receiver_name FROM notification n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.receiver_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = u.id WHERE n.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY n.create_time DESC

SELECT n.id, n.receiver_id as receiver_id, n.is_read as is_read, n.create_time as create_time, IFNULL(u.username, n.receiver_id) as receiver_name, u.email as receiver_email, u.phone as receiver_phone FROM notification n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.receiver_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = u.id WHERE n.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY n.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND is_read = 1

SELECT n.id, n.receiver_id as receiver_id, n.is_read as is_read, n.create_time as create_time, IFNULL(u.username, n.receiver_id) as receiver_name, u.email as receiver_email, u.phone as receiver_phone FROM notification n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.receiver_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id} ORDER BY n.create_time DESC

SELECT n.id, n.receiver_id as receiver_id, n.is_read as is_read, n.create_time as create_time, IFNULL(u.username, n.receiver_id) as receiver_name, u.email as receiver_email, u.phone as receiver_phone FROM notification n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.receiver_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id} LIMIT 0, 1
